page.title: Settings
page.subtitleWrite: Hotels and competitors, who gets alerts, users, PMS data and price strategy
page.subtitleRead: View tracked hotels, alerts, users and PMS data
page.readOnlyNote: View-only account: you can see every setting but can't change anything, except which alerts you receive on the Alerts tab. Contact your hotel admin if something needs editing.

url.notHotelPage: That isn't a hotel page yet. Open the hotel's page on Booking.com and copy its link (like https://www.booking.com/hotel/vn/hotel-name.html).

row.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the group? Its scanned price history is kept and you can add it back any time.

list.emptyWrite: Add your own hotel first (role “Your hotel”), then add competitors in the same segment. Each hotel's rooms and rates are read on Booking.com on the scan schedule.
list.emptyRead: Your admin hasn't added any hotels to track yet.
list.title: Watchlist

list.scanStarted: Scanning started. Results appear on the Rate calendar in a few minutes.

list.compEmpty: No competitors yet. Add the hotels in your segment that you usually compare rates with.
list.legend: Click “Details” for the Booking.com page, room count and primary/secondary group; click ⋯ to change the URL, pause or remove from the group.
list.noneReady: No hotel is ready to scan yet.

compset.tierTitle: Only primary competitors count towards the middle price, listed-price index and price position; secondary ones (seasonal, reference) are still tracked
compset.primaryTitle: Primary competitor: counts towards the middle price, price index and price position
compset.secondaryTitle: Secondary competitor: still tracked, not counted in the middle price or price index
compset.compsetOfTitle: Which of your hotels it is compared with; “Shared” = competitor of all your hotels
compset.roomsTitle: Published total room count, used for the fill indicator and the CoStar 50% rule
compset.sourceTitle: Where the room count comes from: hotel website, MICE directory… (paste a URL); saved with the time it was entered
compset.bookingMax: Booking has offered ≥{count, number} rooms in a night
compset.bookingMaxTitle: Most rooms ever seen left on Booking.com for one night: Booking sells at least that many of the hotel's rooms, not the hotel's total
compset.roomsBelowBooking: The room count ({rooms, number}) is below what Booking has offered (≥{max, number}): please check (Booking may sell dorm beds).
compset.suggest: Booking sells up to {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} a night
compset.suggestCapped: Booking sells ≥{count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} a night
compset.suggestTitle: Suggested from Booking.com (measured {date}): the most rooms the hotel sells in one night, measured with Booking’s calendar over nights 2–4 months ahead. Usually equals the total room count when the hotel puts all its rooms on Booking; lower if it keeps rooms for other channels.
compset.suggestUseAria: Use {count, number} as the room count of {name}
compset.suggestCappedNote: Large hotel: Booking can only be measured up to 100 rooms a night, so enter the room count published on the hotel’s website.
compset.suggestLowerNote: Booking has only shown at least {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} a night, so this cannot be used as the room count: enter the published room count.
compset.sourceBookingMeasuredTitle: Room count taken from the suggestion: the most rooms Booking.com sells in one night (an estimate, not a published figure). Anyone tracking this hotel can replace it with the published count.
compset.suggestBeds: The hotel sells dorm beds on Booking: the number counts beds, so it is higher than the real room count. Enter the real room count.

review.title: Is your competitor group balanced?
review.titleFor: Is the competitor group of {name} balanced?
review.ok: Balanced group: enough competitors, no hotel dominates, prices not far from yours.

warn.too_few: Only {count, plural, one {# primary competitor} other {# primary competitors}}: at least 4 are needed for a meaningful middle price and price index.
warn.dominant_hotel: {name} holds {pct}% of the group's rooms (>50%): one hotel dominates the index.
warn.rooms_unknown: {count, plural, one {# competitor has} other {# competitors have}} no room count: enter it to check the 50% rule.
warn.review_due: The competitor group last changed {date}; review it at least twice a year.
warn.review_due_never: The competitor group hasn't been reviewed yet; review it at least twice a year.

review.rules: Aim for at least 4 primary competitors in your range, no hotel above 50% of the group's rooms, and a review at least twice a year (replace competitors that drift in stars, score or price).

listError.wrongDates: Booking returned a page for different dates than requested (a sign of bot blocking). The scan will retry automatically.
listError.blocked: Booking blocked the list scan; list scanning is paused for a while and will restart automatically.
listError.timeout: Booking responded too slowly for some nights; those nights were skipped and will be scanned next time.
listError.network: Network/proxy error on some nights; those nights were skipped and will be scanned next time.
listError.stuck: The previous scan stopped partway; we rescanned from the first missing night.

config.listNightsHint: Upcoming nights scanned every day (up to 30)
config.maxHotelsHint: Top by review count; reads rooms left for each night. 0 = off
config.horizonHint: Up to 90, scanned in tiers like the comp set
config.maxPagesHint: Maximum requests per night (market, list, room ladder)

scope.radiusHint: Only count properties within this distance of the area's centre (Booking's distance filter)
scope.radiusRequiredHint: Required for an area around a point
scope.segmentHint: Property types that are counted; the sold-out share and room ladder use this segment

add.title: Add market area
add.info: Find an area by name on Booking.com (city, district, landmark) or use a radius around your hotel. A central district or a 1–3 km radius is closer to your competition than a whole city (thousands of properties, including apartments and homestays); the segment limits which property types are counted.
add.searchPlaceholder: e.g. District 1, Vung Tau, Ben Thanh Market
add.noResults: No areas found. Try the English name as used on Booking.com.
add.bigArea: This area has {count, plural, one {# property} other {# properties}}; Booking lists at most 1,000 per search. Add a radius or pick a central district for complete figures.
add.landmarkHint: Use a radius with a landmark so only properties around it are counted.
add.firstScanHint: The first list scan runs at 03:00, or press “Scan list now” after adding.
add.aroundNoCoords: Your hotel has no coordinates yet. They are read when we scan the Booking.com page of the hotel marked “Yours” in the <link>watchlist</link>. Meanwhile, search for the area by name.
add.aroundExists: There is already an area around your hotel (“{name}”). Change its radius or segment below.

area.known: {count, plural, one {# known hotel} other {# known hotels}}
area.alreadyRunning: A list scan is already running
area.deleteConfirm: Delete the area {name}? Its list scan history will be deleted; hotel data is kept.
area.scopeChanged: The new radius and segment apply from the next scan; nights already scanned keep their figures.

market.intro: Reads every property of an area on Booking.com (city, district, landmark or a radius around your hotel), filtered by segment. Each day at 03:00 it counts properties with rooms left, prices, and how many can still sell at least N rooms per night: that is how tight the market is on Booking.com, not occupancy. See it in Market and Competitors › Explore market.
market.emptyBody: Add a district, a landmark or a radius around your hotel to get market indicators for the whole area.

times.title: Scan times
times.hint: Each time triggers a scan of every tracked hotel, in {timezone}. Up to {max} times.
times.keepOne: Keep at least one scan time

scope.title: Scan range and brief
scope.horizonHint: 1 to 90 nights from today; nights further out are scanned less often
scope.insightHourHint: The daily brief uses the latest scan
scope.languageHint: Language of the AI brief, alert emails and weekly report. The web interface is switched separately with the VI/EN button.
scope.timezoneHint: Scan times and the brief time follow this time zone

schedule.cardDescription: How often rooms are counted each day and when the AI brief is generated

form.name: Event name

events.addInfo: Events show on the Rate calendar and Market next to holidays. The demand uplift is your own estimate for the whole team to see; the system doesn't measure it.
events.listDescription: Festivals, conferences, tournaments, travel seasons… that affect room demand around your hotel.
events.emptyBody: Add local events (e.g. F1, fireworks festival, trade fair, peak season) to see them next to market data on the calendar.

sourceMarkets.title: Guest source markets
sourceMarkets.description: Pick the countries your guests often come from. Their holidays (Lunar New Year, Golden Week, Chuseok…) show on the Rate calendar and Today, and count in price suggestions and alerts next to Vietnamese holidays.
sourceMarkets.info: Long holidays in a source market usually lift demand for Vietnam a few days before and during the break. Only the countries you pick are shown.
sourceMarkets.none: No market selected: calendars show Vietnamese holidays only.
sourceMarkets.readOnly: Only the hotel admin can change source markets.

examples.cn: Spring Festival, 1 May, Golden Week 1–7 Oct
examples.au: Spring school break, summer break Dec–Jan

daily_insight.title: Morning brief
daily_insight.describe: Send the AI brief as soon as the daily brief is ready, with links to the evidence.
daily_insight.describeAt: Send the AI brief as soon as the daily brief is ready (around {hour}), with links to the evidence.

weekly_report.title: Weekly report
weekly_report.describe: Monday mornings at 08:00: a summary of competitors over the past 7 days and your next 14 nights.

competitor_sold_out.title: Competitor sold out
competitor_sold_out.describe: When a competitor has just sold out a night within the next <days></days> nights and at least <soldOut></soldOut> competitors are sold out that night.

competitor_low_stock.title: Competitor almost sold out
competitor_low_stock.describe: When a competitor's room type is down to 3 rooms or fewer, for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

competitor_price_drop.title: Competitor rate drop
competitor_price_drop.describe: When a competitor's lowest rate drops by at least <pct></pct> for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

data_stale.title: Stale data
data_stale.describe: When Booking.com data is older than one scan cycle (scans failed or were blocked), so you don't make decisions on stale numbers.

market_tight.title: Tight night
market_tight.describe: When at least <pct></pct> of competitors are sold out or almost sold out (≤3 rooms left) for a night within the next <days></days> nights. Usually a moment to raise rates.

competitor_price_rise.title: Competitor raised rates
competitor_price_rise.describe: When a competitor raises its rate by <pct></pct> or more for the same room type and rate plan, for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

competitor_promo.title: Competitor launched a deep promotion
competitor_promo.describe: When a competitor launches a promotion of <pct></pct> or more off the strikethrough price, for nights within the next <days></days> nights.

own_position_drift.title: Your rate drifted from your price position
own_position_drift.describe: When your listed-price index is more than <pct></pct> away from the price position you chose, for nights within the next <days></days> nights.
own_position_drift.needsStrategy: Off by default. Choose a price position in <link>Price strategy</link> before turning it on.

own_closed.title: You are sold out or closed to arrival on Booking.com
own_closed.describe: When your hotel is sold out or not accepting arrivals that day on Booking.com, for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

competitor_below_median.title: Competitor below the middle price
competitor_below_median.describe: When a competitor has just cut its rate to <pct></pct> or <vnd></vnd> (0 = percentage only) below the competitors' middle price, for nights within the next <days></days> nights.

competitor_above_median.title: Competitor above the middle price
competitor_above_median.describe: When a competitor has just raised its rate to <pct></pct> or <vnd></vnd> (0 = percentage only) above the competitors' middle price, for nights within the next <days></days> nights.

notifications.rulesDescription: Alerts are bundled into one message after each scan, only when changes match the level you pick. Applies to everyone with “Instant alerts” on.
notifications.invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

log.title: Recently sent
log.description: Latest {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}}
log.emptyBody: After the next scan with competitor changes, or when the morning brief is ready, sent messages appear here.

channels.title: Delivery channels
channels.description: Technical status of each channel (operator only). Channels that aren't set up are hidden from hotels.

email.name: Email
email.on: Sends to the email recipients in “Who gets what”.
email.off: Email server (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_FROM) is not configured for the worker.

zalo.name: Zalo ZNS
zalo.on: Zalo messages to subscribed phone numbers, about 200–300₫ per delivered message.
zalo.off: Not configured: needs a verified business Official Account and Zalo-approved templates.

webhook.name: Webhook
webhook.on: Posts JSON to each subscription's https URL (Slack, Google Chat, Discord…).

engagement.title: Message engagement
engagement.description: Last {weeks} weeks by channel: did messages arrive, get opened and get handled?
engagement.info: “Clicks” counts people who opened a link in the message. “Handled” counts people who pressed “Handled” in the message or on this page. Cost is the Zalo ZNS fee; email and webhook are free.
engagement.skippedTitle: Not sent because of quiet hours or the daily cap
engagement.emptyBody: Once the first message goes out by email, Zalo or webhook, weekly sends, clicks and handled counts appear here.

notifications.noChannel: Your operator hasn't turned on message delivery yet; you can still see every alert in the bell 🔔

level.label: Alert level
level.lowHint: Only when a competitor sells out within the next 7 nights, when you sell out on Booking.com, and when data is stale.
level.mediumHint: Same as “Few”, plus competitor sell-outs within 14 nights, competitor price cuts of 10% or more, and tight nights.
level.highHint: Everything: also competitors running low, price rises, deep promotions, cheaper/pricier than the middle price, and your rate drifting from your price position.
level.customHint: You've adjusted individual rules. Pick a level to go back to a preset.

who.title: Who gets what
who.descriptionAdmin: One row per recipient; switch on just the messages they need. Nothing is sent during quiet hours.
who.descriptionViewer: The messages you receive. You can add your own email or phone number.
who.blocked: Can't deliver on this channel yet
who.testSent: Test message sent. Check the inbox (or Zalo) in a few minutes.
who.emptyBody: Add the email or Zalo number of whoever needs to know when competitors sell out or change prices. Every alert still shows in the bell 🔔.
who.legend: Instant alerts: after each scan with changes. Morning brief: what to do over the next 14 nights, plus the brief. Weekly report: Monday morning. Stale data: when Booking.com data is older than one scan cycle.

target.any: Email, Zalo number or webhook URL

form.hint: New recipients get every message, quiet {start}–{end}. Change it right in the table.
form.quietHint: Hotel time; may cross midnight (22:00–06:00). Leave both empty to receive at any time.

invalid.phone: That Vietnamese phone number doesn't look right (e.g. 0912 345 678).
invalid.webhook: The webhook URL must start with https://
invalid.channel: This channel isn't on. Pick another one.
invalid.quiet: Enter both the start and end time (HH:MM).
invalid.quietSame: Start and end times must differ.
invalid.maxPerDay: Max messages/day is a whole number from 1 to 50.
